paragraphs: Readyly sells agentic AI for local government, which the company describes as making citizen service faster, easier, and more human. The homepage frames the problem as routine questions, residents lost in websites and phone menus, and staff at peak capacity during busy times. Stated capabilities include responding to residents 24/7, routing complex issues to the right team, and working in any language, on any channel.

The site says the platform is built for government and integrates with 40+ platforms. Listed functions include automating permits, requests, utility start/stop service, inspection scheduling, and code enforcement. Compliance benchmarks named on the same page are SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001, and NIST AI RMF.

Case studies on the site describe how Los Altos Hills, California, used the platform for 24/7 resident support. One case study describes Mount Vernon New York's Building Department using the platform for permit updates and zoning questions. Another names Sloomoo Institute, which the page says resolves over 83% of visitor chats and emails without staff intervention. The same page asks whether Readyly could work for a city, county, or agency.

quote.text: Readyly delivers Agentic AI for local government—making citizen service faster, easier, and more human.
